refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute a signal from its short-time Fourier transform.

listitem.para: Real or complex matrix representing a signal's short-time fourier transform.
3-element vector C specifying window size, increment and window type.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Compute a signal from its short-time Fourier transform 'y' and a 3-element vector 'c' specifying window size, increment, and window type. A window type of 1 represents a hanning window, 2 represents a hamming window and 3 represents a rectangular window. The values 'y' and 'c' can be derived by [y, c] = stft (x, ...)
